chain.label: High density altitude at H-44
chain.trigger: density altitude of 8,476 feet for the accident takeoff

chain.label: Empty weight intentionally understated
chain.trigger: the intentional understatement of the helicopter's empty weight

chain.label: Takeoff power available chart altered
chain.trigger: the alteration of the power available chart to exaggerate the helicopter's lift capability

chain.label: Unapproved above-min-spec torque practice
chain.trigger: the practice of using unapproved above-minimum specification torque in performance calculations

chain.label: USFS and FAA oversight inadequate
chain.trigger: insufficient oversight by the USFS and the Federal Aviation Administration

chain.label: Load calculations overestimated payload capacity, no real margin
chain.trigger: significantly overestimated the helicopter's load-carrying capacity and did not provide an adequate performance margin for a successful takeoff

caused_by.evidence: the empty weight of 12,408 lbs used by the PIC in determining the helicopter's performance capabilities was incorrect
the substitution of the 2.5-minute power available chart for the takeoff power available chart eliminated this safety margin
Using above-min spec torque equated to an additional 800-lb increase in the calculated HOGE weight capability
effective oversight would likely have identified that Carson Helicopters was using improper weight and performance charts for contract bidding and actual load calculations

chain.label: Trees close to H-44 departure path
chain.trigger: Fifty-foot trees were directly ahead of the LZ

chain.label: Crew proceeded without addressing marginal performance on prior departures
chain.trigger: the failure of the flight crewmembers to address the fact that the helicopter had approached its maximum performance capability on their two prior departures from the accident site because they were accustomed to operating at the limit of the helicopter's performance

caused_by.evidence: the pilots believed the helicopter was 'good to go' with capability beyond that required to HOGE

chain.label: Helicopter struck trees and sloping terrain during climb
chain.trigger: The helicopter collided with the trees and subsequently impacted the down sloping terrain, coming to rest on its left side

caused_by.evidence: the accident takeoff was unsuccessful because the helicopter was loaded with more weight than it could carry in a HOGE given the ambient conditions
the belly of the fuselage contacted trees; it appeared as though the helicopter would fit between trees, though the main rotor blades were not high enough to clear the trees
At 1940:46, the PIC began to increase the power for takeoff

chain.label: Fuel tanks not crash-resistant
chain.trigger: fuel tanks that were not crash resistant

chain.label: Cabin seats and attachments not crash-resistant
chain.trigger: the separation from the floor of the cabin seats that were not crash resistant

chain.label: Inappropriate restraint release mechanism installed
chain.trigger: the use of an inappropriate release mechanism on the cabin seat restraints

chain.label: Nine fatalities from impact and postcrash fire
chain.trigger: the pilot-in-command, the safety crewmember, and seven firefighters were fatally injured

caused_by.evidence: Almost immediately after the impact, witnesses saw smoke and fire coming from the wreckage
the immediate, intense fire that resulted from the spillage of fuel upon impact from the fuel tanks that were not crash resistant
the separation from the floor of the cabin seats that were not crash resistant
the surviving firefighters were unable to release the rotary restraints under emergency conditions because they were unfamiliar with the rotary-release mechanism
